classified.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
classified.basis: Standalone wholeJUnit owns all pools/codecs. WebLog caller-monitor Future5s; old100jobs invokeAll10/Future10, each finally shutdownNow/assert await10 before codec.close. New other-worker Future5s then shutdownNow/await10 before close. Revocation original100 Futures20/two-worker bounded latch20 and finally release/shutdownNow/await10 before close. Codec resource sites are in explicit finally and close only after worker termination; false/interrupt remains failed/unconfirmed, never PASS. No managed application thread, real key, external service or process is created.

classified.message: A throw statement in a finally block makes the control flow hard to understand.
classified.basis: Unconfirmed owned-worker termination must fail Test and leave codec ownership unclaimed, rather than pass or call a potentially blocking close while worker owns lock. shutdownNow precedes await10, original boundedFuture/latches retained.
